title: Canonical quotient of a marked Artinian test algebra
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring, $k$ a finite type $R$-field, and $\mathcal C_{R,k}$ the marked Artinian test category of [def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category]. For a morphism $f:B\to A$ and an ideal $L\subseteq\ker(f)$, define the quotient test $B/L$ to have underlying $R$-algebra the literal ideal quotient and augmentation $[b]\mapsto\overline{f(b)}\in k$. This augmentation makes $B/L$ an Artinian local test with the specified residue field $k$. Define the canonical morphism $B/L\to A$ by $[b]\mapsto f(b)$; its residue compatibility follows from the definition of the augmentation. No surjectivity of $f$ is required for these constructions.
